The '''9th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1951 in film|1951]] films, were held on February 21, 1952, at the [[Ciro's]] nightclub located in [[West Hollywood, California]], at 8433 [[Sunset Boulevard]], on the [[Sunset Strip]].

==Winner and Nominees==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture&nbsp;— Drama]]===
''' ''[[A Place in the Sun (1951 film)|A Place in the Sun]]'''''
*''[[Bright Victory]]''
*''[[Detective Story (1951 film)|Detective Story]]''
*''[[Quo Vadis (1951 film)|Quo Vadis]]''
*''[[A Streetcar Named Desire (1951 film)|A Streetcar Named Desire]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Picture&nbsp;— Comedy or Musical]]===
''' ''[[An American in Paris (film)|An American in Paris]]'''''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1951 |title=The 9th Annual Golden Globe Awards (1952) |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174054/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1951 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture — Drama]]===
''' [[Fredric March]] – ''[[Death of a Salesman (1951 film)|Death of a Salesman]]'''''
*[[Arthur Kennedy (actor)|Arthur Kennedy]] – ''[[Bright Victory]]''
*[[Kirk Douglas]] – ''[[Detective Story (1951 film)|Detective Story]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture&nbsp;— Drama]]===
''' [[Jane Wyman]] – ''[[The Blue Veil (1951 film)|The Blue Veil]]'''''
*[[Shelley Winters]] – ''[[A Place in the Sun (1951 film)|A Place in the Sun]]''
*[[Vivien Leigh]] – ''[[A Streetcar Named Desire (1951 film)|A Streetcar Named Desire]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture&nbsp;— Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Danny Kaye]] – ''[[On the Riviera]]'''''
*[[Bing Crosby]] – ''[[Here Comes the Groom (1951 film)|Here Comes the Groom]]''
*[[Gene Kelly]] – ''[[An American in Paris (film)|An American in Paris]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture&nbsp;— Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[June Allyson]] – ''[[Too Young to Kiss]]'''''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Peter Ustinov]] – ''[[Quo Vadis (1951 film)|Quo Vadis]]'''''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===
''' [[Kim Hunter]] – ''[[A Streetcar Named Desire (1951 film)|A Streetcar Named Desire]]'''''
*[[Thelma Ritter]] – ''[[The Mating Season (film)|The Mating Season]]''
*[[Lee Grant]] – ''[[Detective Story (1951 film)|Detective Story]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director&nbsp;— Motion Picture]]===
''' [[László Benedek]] – ''[[Death of a Salesman (1951 film)|Death of a Salesman]]'''''
*[[Vincente Minnelli]] – ''[[An American in Paris (film)|An American in Paris]]''
*[[George Stevens]] – ''[[A Place in the Sun (1951 film)|A Place in the Sun]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay|Best Screenplay&nbsp;— Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[Bright Victory]]'' – [[Robert Buckner]] '''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score|Best Music, Original Score&nbsp;— Motion Picture]]===
''' ''[[September Affair]]'' – composed by [[Victor Young]] '''
*''[[The Well (1951 film)|The Well]]'' – composed by [[Dimitri Tiomkin]]
*''[[The Day the Earth Stood Still]]'' – [[Bernard Herrmann]]

===Cinematography — Black and White===
''' ''[[Death of a Salesman (1951 film)|Death of a Salesman]]'' – [[Franz F. Planer]] '''
*''[[Decision Before Dawn]]'' – [[Franz F. Planer]]
*''[[A Place in the Sun (1951 film)|A Place in the Sun]]'' – [[William C. Mellor]]

===Cinematography&nbsp;— Color===
''' ''[[Quo Vadis (1951 film)|Quo Vadis]]'' – photographed by [[William V. Skall]] '''

===Promoting International Understanding===
''' ''[[The Day the Earth Stood Still]]'' – [[Robert Wise]] '''

===Special Achievement Award===
'''[[Alain Resnais]]'''

===Henrietta Award (World Film Favorites)===
''' [[Esther Williams]] '''

===[[Golden Globe Award for New Star of the Year – Actor|New Star of the Year Actor]]===
'''[[Kevin McCarthy (actor)|Kevin McCarthy]]'''
